clues.it: Carla era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a un gargoyle e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Carla was in the 8th column, beside a gargoyle and north of Elena.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una libreria e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Tea was beside a bookcase and west of Carla.

clues.it: Vito era nella 3ª riga e nelle Cucine, ma non era accanto a un gargoyle.
clues.en: Vito was in the 3rd row and in the Kitchens, but was not beside a gargoyle.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª riga e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th row and north of Irene.

clues.it: Anna era nella 5ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Vito.
clues.en: Anna was in the 5th column, in the 6th row and in a different room from Vito.

clues.it: Sergio era da solo in Armeria, ma non era accanto a un tappeto.
clues.en: Sergio was alone in the Armory, but was not beside a rug.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a uno sgabello e nelle Segrete, ma non era accanto a una torcia.
clues.en: Irene was beside a stool and in the Dungeon, but was not beside a torch.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 2ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Irene.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 2nd column, in the 9th row and in the same room as Irene.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 3ª riga: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 3rd row: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 3ª riga: escludendola, a Tea resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 3rd row: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 8th, column 4th.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Sergio resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 7th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «3 persone nelle Cucine» non torna senza Giada: deve stare in riga 5ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: The general clue “3 people in the Kitchens” cannot add up without Giada: they must be at row 5th, column 6th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone nella Sala del Trono» non torna senza Elena: deve stare in riga 4ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Throne Room” cannot add up without Elena: they must be at row 4th, column 1st.
